qualification_note: a same-operator public rehearsal of the paid software-work loop on the Service Actor rail; Gate D acceptance needs an external pilot with a buyer outside the core team, an independent provider and an independently operated resolver or endpoint set
proves: OpenFox nodes on two machines sell software work through a fresh Service Actor on a public TOS test network, with Quotes from the gateway and every packet carried by the installed relays; the sales end responded, refunded and swept

network.label: epoch-7 public testnet
network.endpoints: three validator loopback JSON-RPC listeners of distinct epoch-7 validators, run by the project operator and reached through SSH port forwards; the network, funding and actor code checks read all three

source_commits.openfox_pr_head_note: the run's commit plus a test-only commit (gateway Quote deadline red control); the runner and the fix are unchanged

topology.provider_host: provider node, gateway, protocol RPC and the TLS terminator on loopback; reaches the validators through SSH port forwards
topology.buyer_host: a separate public VPS running the buyer node; reaches the chain and the gateway only through a reverse SSH tunnel bound to its 127.0.0.1
topology.relays: relay-1 and relay-2, the installed Agent Packet Relay daemons, reached over HTTPS with their private CA pinned; never stopped, started or logged in to by the run
topology.direct_peers: none; every task and result packet travelled through the relays

funding.source: epoch-7 bootstrap wallet, sent by the testnet operator from its operations journal

sales.label: R0
sales.quote_source: offer file (the buyer learns the provider's relay key card from it)

sales.label: R1
sales.earlier_refused_purchase: attempt 5's R1 was refused by the gateway before any value was sent (next_request_id unchanged)

sales.label: S
sales.scenario: provider paused and buyer node stopped; the response deadline and the refund window lapsed

sweep_expired_request.note: the sweeper is paid the cleanup bounty; the price returns to the caller (buyer wallet)

sales.label: F
sales.scenario: provider paused, buyer node running; the buyer's refund duty refunds after the response deadline
sales.refund_transactions_source: the actor's transaction list read by the run (rpc-transcript.jsonl, last getTransactions): the two buyer-wallet messages after F's response deadline, in order

attempts.failure: the sale storage fee was below 0.1 TOS plus the cleanup bounty, so the offer was refused
attempts.fix: the runner's storage fee covers the bounty; a rerun resumes the staged run

attempts.failure: protocol RPC refuses a tosctl that is not root-owned
attempts.fix: the owner installed a root-owned copy of the pinned tosctl for the gateway host; the runner uses it

attempts.failure: the offer file was not handed to the buyer host, so the offer-file purchase found no file
attempts.fix: the runner copies the offer file to the buyer host

attempts.failure: a stale buyer serve pid/exit file from the earlier attempt made the resumed buyer serve look stopped
attempts.fix: a resumed run clears the stale buyer serve pid and exit files

attempts.failure: OpenFox bug: gateway Quote requests carried no deadline (DeadlineUnixMillis 0), so the gateway refused every gateway-quoted purchase with 'discovery request deadline expired'; sale R0 (offer file) had already passed all 12 post-sale checks in this attempt
attempts.fix: pkg/servicebridge/quotes.go stamps a bounded future deadline (the caller's sooner deadline or one minute)

attempts.failure: binaries rebuilt between attempts were not restaged on the hosts
attempts.fix: the runner restages binaries whose pinned digest changed

attempts.failure: the resumed offer check expected next_request_id 0 although sale R0 had completed
attempts.fix: a resumed offer must return the earlier actor with its completed purchases

attempts.failure: the resumed run repeated sale R0's post-sale checks, which cannot pass twice
attempts.fix: a resumed run does not repeat sale R0's post-sale checks once passed (marker written from attempt 5's evidence)

attempts.note: resumed the staged run and ran sales R1, S and F, the final withdrawal, the relay check and teardown; sale R0 was not repeated

no_value_sent_twice: once-only send markers guarded every value transfer across the nine attempts; a refused purchase left next_request_id unchanged

findings.summary: a buyer seals each task to the provider's relay key card; a gateway Quote carries no card, so a gateway-quoted first purchase cannot reach a relay-only provider
findings.workaround_in_this_run: sale R0 was an offer-file purchase, from which the buyer learned the card; R1, S and F then used gateway Quotes
findings.fix: being built as ai PR 4b (not yet merged): the provider publishes its card, the gateway returns it next to the Quote and the buyer verifies it

findings.summary: OpenFox sent gateway Quote requests without a deadline and every gateway-quoted purchase was refused
findings.fix: openfox commit 50c473fbaf827334015c28c7ec695e278b279b22 (pkg/servicebridge/quotes.go), with a red-control test that drives the real Quote path against an in-process discovery service

known_limitations: the gateway ran on loopback behind a TLS terminator with a private CA, not as public HTTPS (Gate F)
one project operator runs all validators, both relays, the gateway, the provider and the buyer
the relay TTL is 1 h in test, so the deposited task packets of sales S and F expired unread at the relays, as intended
no third-party Service Actor resolve/verify tool exists yet; reconstruction by a second resolver is not recorded
gateway discovery (List/Search) and catalog publication were not exercised
node crash windows were not exercised

preflight_not_passing.message: endpoints have distinct authorities, but whether distinct operators run them is not verified; a quorum of one operator's endpoints is one point of trust
tosctl offers no way to resolve wallet "provider" without signing, so the respond wallet is not checked; preflight never signs

evidence_files.attempt_5_note: sale R0 passed all post-sale checks including the withdrawal in attempt 5; attempt 5 as a whole failed at R1 (the deadline bug)
evidence_files.location: kept by the operator with the run's transcripts; not published
